subject: RE: Flikweert Vision & Encord | Path forward
text:
Hi Kamil,

Apologies for coming back to this once more. While reviewing the agreement in more detail, there is one point that I need to address because it is essential for us.

Section 4.3 grants Encord a worldwide, royalty-free licence over all Client Input. Given the nature of our business and the value of the data we will be putting into the platform, this is something we simply cannot agree to. Our data is a core strategic asset, and we cannot allow any contractual interpretation that would give Encord rights to use, analyse, reuse or benefit from that data beyond what is strictly required to operate the service for us.
Joas mentioned that the intention on your side is that:

  *   Flikweert Vision always remains the sole owner of all data; and
  *   Encord will not use our data for any purpose other than delivering the service to us (and will not use it for model training, product improvement, or for other customers).
If that is indeed our shared understanding, then the agreement needs to reflect it explicitly.
The current wording in 4.3 does not provide that clarity.

To be clear:
We are not willing to grant any broad or open-ended licence over our data. The only rights Encord should receive are the minimal, strictly necessary technical rights to host and process our data solely for the purpose of providing the service to Flikweert Vision.

Could you please update the contract and add the following accordingly so that it is unambiguous that:

  1.  Encord receives no rights to Client Input beyond what is required to technically operate the service;
  2.  Client Input will never be used to train models, improve Encord’s products, or be shared (even in anonymised form) outside our own tenancy; and
  3.  All ownership and substantive rights remain exclusively with Flikweert Vision.
  4.
Thanks for your understanding
I’m sure we can resolve this easily once the wording is aligned with our intention.

Kind regards,

Martijn Flikweert
Co-Founder & CEO

subject: Re: scaling data annotation
text:
Hi Moritz,

Sorry I missed your first email.

Thanks for reaching out — and appreciate the kind words about Dapster.

Encord’s work with CV/ML teams like Weave and Zipline is impressive.
VLM-ready data infrastructure is definitely aligned with where the space is
heading.

That said, we’re currently in the middle of a heavy push on fundraising and
customer onboarding, with most of our engineering bandwidth focused on the
hardware side of the stack. Because of that, this isn’t the right moment
for us to engage deeply on data infrastructure discussions.

I’d suggest checking back with us around *February next year* — that’s when
we expect to revisit scaling our data pipelines more actively, and it would
be great to reconnect then.

Thanks again for reaching out, and wishing you continued success with
Encord.

Best,
Nihaal
